note: AUTHORED, NOT CAPTURED. Three turns, and the one a local run measures best: turn 1 stages a share-out, turn 2's typed 'cancel' becomes the model's `proposal_resolve` call which the loop authorizes against the pending card, and turn 3 repeats the EXACT ask — where Turn's gate idempotency reads the '(Cancelled the proposed shareout_post …)' marker out of the seeded store and bounces rather than re-carding. Turn 3's recorded reply is a re-proposal ON PURPOSE: the deterministic check expects `text`, so it passes only if the turn refuses to stage what the model asked for. That is Turn's rule, not the model's, and it is exactly the kind of thing a recording can measure honestly.
